title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - AvailabilityZone
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/AvailabilityZone. An availability zone is an aggregation of resources - physical and abstract - in a non-redundant setup often associated with a single datacenter room. Subclass of Resource per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Resource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AvailabilityZone'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

address.description: Relationship. The physical address associated with the availability zone. Links to an Address entity.
